# MAHT Overview

Date: 2026-06-05

This archive preserves the decision path used during AOIA-Core reviewer-readiness work after the MAHT-style audit divergence.

## What This Archive Shows

- External models generated audit hypotheses rather than authoritative implementation instructions.
- Agreement between external audits was recorded, but disagreement was also preserved instead of normalized away.
- Bounded experiments were used to test contested claims, especially around packaging and import-layout repair.
- Failed experiments and out-of-scope paths were documented explicitly instead of being hidden.
- Repository changes were accepted only after validation, scope control, and checkpoint discipline.

## Repository Interpretation

These materials should be read as audit-process evidence, not as runtime specifications and not as direct implementation authority.

In particular, the import-layout repair audit series documents why temporary compatibility measures, rejected alternatives, and deferred refactor decisions were preserved as part of reviewer-readiness evidence.

## Boundary Note

This archive belongs to the AOIA-Core documentation trail for external review preparation.

It is not GT-RUNTIME-9.
It is not a runtime change.
It is not a packaging implementation by itself.
